blocks.html: The details of a shipping option that customers can choose from during checkout.

types.name: name
types.description: The shipping option's name. Customers can see this name during checkout.

types.name: price_type
types.description:
The type of the shipping option's price:

- `flat`: the price is a fixed amount available in the `amount` property.
- `calculated`: the price is calculated during checkout by the shipping option's fulfillment provider. Retrieve the price using the [Calculate Shipping Option Price API route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#shipping-options\_postshippingoptionsidcalculate).

types.name: service_zone_id
types.description: The ID of the service zone that the shipping option belongs to.

types.name: provider_id
types.description: The ID of the fulfillment provider that processes the shipping option's fulfillments and, for calculated shipping options, computes its price.

types.name: provider
types.description: The fulfillment provider that processes the shipping option's fulfillments.

children.name: is_enabled
children.description: Whether the fulfillment provider is enabled.

types.name: shipping_option_type_id
types.description: The ID of the shipping option's type.

children.name: shipping_option_id
children.description: The ID of the shipping option this type belongs to.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the shipping option type was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the shipping option type was last updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the shipping option type was deleted.

types.name: shipping_profile_id
types.description: The ID of the shipping profile that the shipping option belongs to.

types.name: amount
types.description:
The shipping option's price amount.

For a shipping option whose `price_type` is `calculated`, this amount is
resolved by the fulfillment provider during checkout, so it isn't reliable
until the price is calculated using the Calculate Shipping Option Price API route.

types.name: is_tax_inclusive
types.description: Whether the shipping option's amount is tax inclusive.

types.name: data
types.description: Additional data that is useful for the shipping option's fulfillment provider.

types.name: metadata
types.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the shipping option.
